The '''Crystalview Cantina''' was an open-air [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the hidden township of [[Aurilia]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was built after the reconstruction of the village, following the [[battle of Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Denizens of Aurilia often spent their time in the cantina. It also provided enough space for live [[Entertainer|entertainment]].<ref name="SWG:A" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crystalview Cantina appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Crystalview Cantina was added to the game along with the revamped city of [[W:c:swg:Aurilia|Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>

The cantina offered players of the [[:w:c:swg:Entertainer|entertainer profession]] a place to perform their music and dances in Aurilia. Its name was revealed by signs in front of the cantina area.<ref name="SWG:A" />
